reason: I make about $500 a month and $89 is a big bite for a tool I have never needed. Telegram and my notebook work fine, and I would not pay for a CRM before I see it earn money.
objection: AI calls and voice are not working yet, and only 1 to 5 companies pay. For $89 a month I am paying for promises with no references.
would_change_my_mind: A free plan or a price under $15 a month that handles my Telegram chats, plus a shop owner I know who uses it and says it works.
